rationale: It reuses the archive's CapexRDOverGoodwillMix skeleton (capex growth × [good-intangible − goodwill] spread) with only the "good" leg swapped, and the swap is economically weak because identifiable intangibles (intan − gdwl) are overwhelmingly created by the very same purchase-price allocations that generate goodwill, so the two legs are highly correlated and the spread largely reflects deal accounting rather than organic capability.

This is the archive's strongest signal (CapexRDOverGoodwillMix) with both conditioning legs converted from flows/changes to levels/stocks — a defensible stock-vs-flow distinction but still a same-skeleton variant that also overlaps AssetLightKnowledgeDeployment's R&D-stock-to-assets leg, so it risks being a cosmetic re-run rather than a new mechanism.

This is GoodwillSalesYieldShortfall from the archive with the aqc/at gate replaced by capex growth — the identical signed spread and near-identical economic story make it a rediscovery, and the aqc→capx substitution actually weakens the mechanism since capex growth is not an acquisition indicator.

The core content is the well-published stock-financed-acquirer underperformance (Loughran-Vijh, Rau-Vermaelen) plus the archive's goodwill-versus-R&D spread, and the triple multiplication of two [0,1] ranks against a signed spread will collapse most of the cross-section toward zero while intersecting sstk, aqc, and xrd availability drives coverage very low.

The trend-based contrast of knowledge-intensity deepening versus physical-capital deepening, gated on revenue expansion, is a genuinely different construction from the archive's capex-growth/goodwill family and articulates a coherent scalable-growth mechanism, though the nonnegative RANK(sale growth) gate means low-growth firms are all pinned near zero and COALESCE(xrd,0) creates a large tie mass at the bottom of the R&D-trend rank.

The inventory-growth leg is a known anomaly (Thomas-Zhang) and is reused verbatim from InventoryBuildNoMarginCushion, but replacing the margin conditioner with a tangibility-minus-knowledge-stock spread is a substantively different economic gate worth one test; be aware the COALESCE(xrd,0) leg mostly separates R&D reporters from non-reporters rather than measuring knowledge stock intensity.
